commitment: Snowman consensus: an accepted block is deterministically final (irreversible, no reorg), ~1-2s. Single tier, the receipt IS true finality (no separate hard-finality tier).
method: N real USDC ERC-20 self-payments pre-signed with consecutive EVM nonces and fired at once. Avalanche's mempool queues future-nonce txs and a block packs many consecutive ones, so one wallet CAN burst. Timed submit -> receipt (block acceptance), which on Avalanche is deterministic finality (no reorg).
